About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: Firuzo is your digital travel companion — flights, hotels and city services across the region, all in one platform.

story.title: We made travel simple
story.p1: Firuzo began with a simple idea: travelling to Iran and across the region should be as easy as the journey you imagine. Today, our all-in-one platform brings every travel need — flights, hotels, cultural tours and city services — together in one place.
story.p2: Our team is on the ground in 7 countries, from airport meet-and-greet and private transfers to interpreters and round-the-clock support. Backed by technology and deep local knowledge, we make every domestic and international trip hassle-free.
story.p3: Every day thousands of travellers plan and go with Firuzo — and every day we work to make your next trip the easiest one yet.

values.title: Why Firuzo?

values.v2Desc: 24/7 support at every step of the journey, from booking to the flight home.
values.v3Desc: AI trip planner, live fare comparison and instant ticketing.
values.v4Desc: Multi-currency wallet with secure local and international payments.
